1. Scope — Covers the dimensions and other requirements for hand and machine operated circular 
screwing dies for taper pipe threads (R-series) according to IS : 554-1985 'Dimensions for pipe 
threads where pressure tight joints are required on the threads (third revision)' 

2. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1. 

3. General Requirements 

3.1 The circular screwing dies for taper pipe R-series threads shall be provided with chamfer on 
larger diameter. 

3.2 The dimensions of taper threads for dies shall be such as to produce pipe threads within the 
specified tolerance given in IS ; 554-1985. 

3.3 For requirements not covered in this standard, it shall conform to IS : 12320-1988 Technical 
supply conditions for circular screwing dies'. 

4. Designation 

4.1 A circular screwing die, for cutting taper pipe threads (R-series), having nominal size 1/4, made 
of high speed steel and conforming to this standard shall be designated as: 

Circular Screwing Die R 1/4 IS : 12322. HSS 

5. Sampling — The sampling and criteria of acceptance shall be according to IS : 7778-1975 
'Methods for sampling small tools'. 

6. Standard Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards.

Note 1 —The dimension (a?) of the V-groove, diameter ^3 and the number of clearance holes are left to manufacturer's 
descretion 

Note 2 — The chamfer of the screwing dies shall be calculated on the basis of two threads. 

Note 3 — In case of non-precision screwing dies, tolerance on ^2 and h^ shall be hl1 and hi 2, respectively. 



IS : 12322-1988 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

The requirements of thread cutting dies were earlier covered under IS : 1859-1961. IS : 1859 is 
being modified and replaced by a series of standards to include various requirements pertaining to 
screwing dies which have been felt necessary at the national and international level. The title of the 
standard is also being modified as 'Circular screwing dies' in place of Thread cutting dies' so as to 
bring it in line with the terminology agreed to at the international level. 

The series of standards are as follows: 

General dimensions for circular screwing dies 

Technical supply conditions for circular screwing dies 

Circular screwing dies for ISO metric screw threads 

Circular screwing dies for taper pipe threads — R series 

Circular screwing dies for parallel pipe threads — G series 

Hexagonal die nuts 

Circular screwing dies for ISO metric conduit pipe threads 

On the publication of above standards, IS : 1859 will stand withdrawn. 

In the preparation of this standard, considerable assistance has been derived from: 

a) ISO 2568-1973 Hand- and machine-operated circular screwing dies and hand operated die 
stocks. International Organization for Standardization (ISO). 

b) ISO 4230-1987 Hand- and machine-operated circular screwing dies for taper pipe threads — 
R-series. International Organization for Standardization (ISO), 

c) DIN 5159-1986 Circular screwing dies' for taper pipe threads R 1/16 to R 2. Deutsches Institut 
fur Normung (DIN).
